```{python}
#| label: fig-process-wells
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "CMOS process, steps 2 and 3—well formation: (a) a mask covers the right half of the wafer while boron is implanted to form the p-well, (b) the complementary mask is used for the phosphorus implant of the n-well, and (c) after annealing, both wells are formed."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil import process as pr

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(6.5, 6.2))

ax = axs[0]
pr.wafer(ax, pwell=True, trenches=pr.STI_X)
pr.sti(ax)
pr.resist(ax, openings=[(0, pr.WELL_X)], y=pr.SURF)
pr.implant_arrows(ax, y0=6.2, y1=5.2, label='boron implant')
pr.setup(ax, '(a) p-well implant (mask over the n-well region)', ymax=7.2)

ax = axs[1]
pr.wafer(ax, pwell=True, nwell=True, trenches=pr.STI_X)
pr.sti(ax)
pr.resist(ax, openings=[(pr.WELL_X, pr.XMAX)], y=pr.SURF)
pr.implant_arrows(ax, y0=6.2, y1=5.2, label='phosphorus implant')
pr.setup(ax, '(b) n-well implant (mask over the p-well region)', ymax=7.2)

ax = axs[2]
pr.wafer(ax, pwell=True, nwell=True, trenches=pr.STI_X)
pr.sti(ax)
pr.setup(ax, '(c) after annealing and mask removal', ymax=5.4)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
